title: Review Status
description: Schema for independently-reviewed outcome status using the canonical flat provenance model. An outcome satisfies independently-reviewed when all required fields are present and the validator identity is distinct from the producer identity.

completed.description: Whether the outcome is marked complete

produced_by_actor_id.description: Unique identifier for the producing actor

produced_by_harness_id.description: Unique identifier for the producing harness

validated_by_actor_id.description: Unique identifier for the validating actor (must differ from produced_by_actor_id)

validated_by_harness_id.description: Unique identifier for the validating harness (must differ from produced_by_harness_id)

validated_at.description: ISO-8601 timestamp of when validation occurred

validation_artifact.description: File path to the durable validation evidence artifact

validation_method.description: Description of the validation approach used
